sections.title: 1. Technical Introduction (Purpose, Scope, Definitions)
sections.body:
### 1.1 Purpose
This Software Requirements Specification (SRS) defines the technical requirements for the Hospital EMR Patient Portal. The document serves as a baseline for design, implementation, and verification of the system.

### 1.2 Scope
The system is a patient-facing portal integrated with the Hospital Electronic Medical Record (EMR) system, enabling patients to manage their health information securely.

### 1.3 Definitions
- **EMR**: Electronic Medical Record.
- **PHI**: Protected Health Information.
- **HIPAA**: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act.

sections.title: 2. Overall Description & System Architecture
sections.body: The Patient Portal operates as a web-based application interfacing with the core Hospital EMR system. The architecture supports secure data exchange, user authentication, and patient self-service capabilities. The system is designed to handle sensitive healthcare data in compliance with industry standards.

sections.title: 3. Functional Requirements
table: Implement secure user login and session management for patients.
Enable patients to view their medical records and appointment schedules.

sections.title: 4. Non-Functional Requirements (Performance, Security, Reliability mapped to domain standards)
sections.body:
### 4.1 Performance
The system must maintain a P95 latency of less than 250ms for standard portal interactions, per healthcare domain NFR benchmarks.

### 4.2 Security (Revised)
- **Encryption at Rest**: All Protected Health Information (PHI) stored in the database must be encrypted using AES-256 or an equivalent standard, per HIPAA §164.312(a)(2)(iv).
- **Audit Logging**: The system must implement comprehensive audit logging for all access to and modifications of PHI. Logs must record the user, timestamp, action, and data accessed, and must be tamper-evident, per HIPAA §164.312(b).

sections.title: 5. External Interface Requirements (APIs, UI, Hardware)
sections.body:
### 5.1 APIs
The portal will consume RESTful APIs provided by the Hospital EMR system to retrieve patient data.

### 5.2 UI
The user interface must be accessible via standard web browsers and support responsive design for mobile devices.

sections.title: 6. System Constraints & Compliance Verification
sections.body: The system must comply with all applicable HIPAA regulations. Compliance verification will be conducted through security audits and penetration testing prior to deployment. Data residency and backup policies must align with hospital IT infrastructure standards.
